Rina P.: Posted PR #5077 — compact 'cheat sheet' appendix for Private/VPC installs: rollback steps, minimal KMS fallbacks for air-gapped sites, and HSM sanity checks. Need quick review.

Owen L.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5077. Link-checker flagged one broken anchor in certs: /docs/private/certs#chain-check -> 404.

Docs Bot: link-checker: PR #5077 -> broken anchor /docs/private/certs#chain-check. Suggest /docs/private/certs#verify-chain.

Camila G.: For rollback, add explicit safe commands. My suggestion: `rwinfctl rollback --to-version v2026.03 --force` (note: triggers db migration revert if present). Then before start: `rwinf-admin cache flush --prefix=model:` (must run to avoid model metadata mismatch).

Rina P.: Adding systemd graceful restart pattern too: `sudo systemctl stop redwood-inference && tar -xzf /opt/redwood/releases/v2026.03.tgz -C /opt/redwood && sudo systemctl start redwood-inference`. Call out graceful shutdown preferred over kill -9.

Harpreet S.: HSM checklist to include: list slots `pkcs11-tool --list-slots --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so`, confirm token label matches `/etc/redwood/hsm.conf`, then `pkcs11-tool --login --slot <id>` to validate PIN. Note device node perms: `chown root:redwood /dev/ttyHSM0; chmod 660 /dev/ttyHSM0`.

Owen L.: KMS fallback snippets please: Python env approach + explicit config. Small examples ok.

Camila G.: Python config example: ```python
from rwinf_sdk import Client
c = Client(config={"kms": "local", "kms_path": "/var/lib/local-kms/keys"})
``` And env example: `export RW_KMS=local && export RW_KMS_PATH=/var/lib/local-kms/keys` then `Client()` picks it up. Add note: test in non-prod VPC.

Rina P.: Add NodeJS minimal example too (for docs parity): ```js
process.env.RW_KMS = 'local'
process.env.RW_KMS_PATH = '/var/lib/local-kms/keys'
const rwinf = require('rwinf-sdk')
const c = new rwinf.Client()
``` Mention socket perms (chown/chmod).

Harpreet S.: Include a KMS healthcheck one-liner: `curl --fail --connect-timeout 3 https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz || echo 'kms-unreachable'`. Note `-k` only for internal self-signed certs.

Owen L.: Small networking caveat: MTU/gRPC fragmentation may require lowering MTU on some clouds. Add test: `ping -M do -s 1372 <peer>` and expected behavior.

Camila G.: Also include a short cert-rotation sanity step: run `openssl s_client -connect hsm.local:8443 -showcerts` and validate chain; re-run `pkcs11-tool --list-token-objects --login`.

Rina P.: I'll fix the broken anchor to /docs/private/certs#verify-chain, add all snippets, and push. Ping when link-checker passes.

Docs Bot: automated-checks: please wrap code blocks with fences. link-checker will re-run on push.

Harpreet S.: Quick manual: will smoke-test PKCS#11 mapping in staging after PR merge. If green, merge. :thumbsup:

Rina P.: Thanks everyone — plan to merge after link-checker green and Harpreet thumbs up. :shipit:
